insights.one_liner: Lear is a large US automotive supplier making car seating and electrical systems, with one English-language engineering job in Enschede.

culture.text: A huge company: about 53,288 people on LinkedIn, mostly in operations, engineering and quality assurance.
Staff often studied business, mechanical, industrial or electrical engineering, and supply chain management.
Headquartered in Southfield, Michigan; it designs and builds seating and E-Systems for major carmakers.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, a hardware and engineering role in Enschede, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Reported second quarter 2026 results and raised its full-year guidance.
Raised its share buyback authorisation to $1.5 billion and extended it.

worth_knowing.text: Detroit's top legal officer faces an ethics probe over her role at Lear.
